correctness.rationale: For formal s, the hub Schur complement of I-sL is S=1-sA-s²∑w_i²/(1-sw_i). The coefficients of S⁻¹ through s³ are 1,A,A²+B,A³+2AB+C. Multiplying this series by -sw_i/(1-sw_i) or by s²w_iw_j/[(1-sw_i)(1-sw_j)] gives the claimed entries. The distinct-leaf quadratic is positive since 3W_ij>(A+w_i+w_j)²; the diagonal is positive by the fourth exponential Taylor bound and the spectral theorem. The spoke difference uses exactly the same positive leaf quadratic. Normalizing by A gives the stated derivative certificate (B/A²≤1), so the largest spoke has a single crossing, with exactly the stated ties. When m=1 there are no leaf-pair conditions. The polynomial in M=I-hL with nonnegative coefficients and a positive linear term gives strict spoke positivity at the Euler endpoint. Independent exact algebra passed with python3 /workspace/checks/rk4_algebra.py; the uploaded program was inspected, not executed.
